landing.heroTitle: From community needs to measurable, verifiable impact
landing.heroSubtitle: A digital platform connecting associations, volunteers, and community initiatives to structure local civic action.
landing.challengeTitle: The Challenge: Fragmented initiatives and lack of unified tracking tools
landing.challengeSubtitle: Civil society has strong volunteer energy but faces organizational barriers in coordination and documentation.
landing.challenge1Desc: Reliance on unstructured channels makes matching volunteers by skill and commune difficult.
landing.challenge2Desc: Associations and volunteers lack a digital log that separates self-reported hours from verified contributions.
landing.challenge3Desc: General estimates often blur the line between planned targets, self-reported claims, and verified outcomes.
landing.approachTitle: The NEXUS DZ Approach: Structured field workflows and data transparency
landing.approachSubtitle: A technical framework linking each field activity to clear tasks and explicit review states.
landing.pillar1Desc: Dedicated workspace for each association to organize its administrative details and local projects.
landing.pillar2Desc: Break initiatives into clear field tasks with required skills, schedules, and target metrics.
landing.pillar3Desc: Record self-reported contribution hours linked to field tasks pending review.
landing.pillar4Desc: Self-reported figures are never merged into verified impact counters without independent review.
landing.ctaTitle: Test and Help Shape the NEXUS DZ Prototype
landing.ctaSubtitle: We welcome local associations and volunteers in Constantine to preview the prototype and share feedback.

about.title: About the NEXUS DZ Initiative
about.subtitle: An independent civic-tech project focused on volunteer coordination and transparent social impact measurement.
about.missionBody: NEXUS DZ was created to provide associations and volunteers with structured digital tools. By combining field task management with a strict separation between planned, reported, and verified impact, the platform promotes transparency in community work.
about.scopeBody: This prototype focuses on the municipalities of Constantine (Constantine Center, El Khroub, Ali Mendjeli, Ain Smara, Hamma Bouziane, Didouche Mourad, Zighoud Youcef) to test workflows prior to central backend deployment.
about.gov1: Independence: NEXUS DZ is an independent civic-tech project, not an official government portal.
about.gov2: Strict distinction between local trial data and officially verified records.
about.gov3: Conflict-of-interest prevention: an organizing entity cannot certify its own impact claims.
about.gov4: Privacy respect: volunteer data is never sold or used for commercial purposes.

impact.title: Transparency Portal & Social Impact Methodology
impact.subtitle: A public registry illustrating the distinction between planned, reported, and verified impact without fabricated numbers.

impact.methodologySubtitle: Ensuring targets and self-reported declarations are never confused with certified results
impact.methodologyDesc: The platform enforces a strict rule: (Planned Impact ≥ Reported Impact ≥ Verified Impact). Verified counters remain at 0 until an independent backend verification service is connected.
impact.step1Desc: Initial targets defined by an association when designing an initiative prior to field execution.
impact.step2Desc: Hours and reports logged locally by participants after an activity, held in pending status.
impact.step3Desc: Impact certified by an independent reviewer via backend server (currently disabled in the local prototype).
